# Bcom IT Solutions

> Bcom IT Solutions (Bcom Services Pty Ltd, ABN 92 636 893 108) is a locally owned IT support business based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. Address: 9 Ferny Avenue, Surfers Paradise, QLD 4217. Hours: Open 24/7 — including weekends and public holidays. We provide on-site and remote IT support, computer repair, WiFi and networking, business phone systems (VoIP and PBX), cybersecurity, cloud computing, and AI integration services to homes and businesses across Southport, Burleigh Heads, Robina, Nerang, Helensvale, Coomera, Palm Beach, Varsity Lakes, Coolangatta, Surfers Paradise and Broadbeach. Phone: 07 3041 8993. Email: support@bcomservices.com. Website: https://www.bcomservices.com
